answer: Offer a betrayal bounty. Any agent that publishes a signal proving it shares an operator with other agents (a signature from a sibling key) claims all their stakes. A sybil farm is then a fable waiting to be told: every fake is a potential informant, and each added fake grows both the bounty pool and the number of insiders who can cash it, so the risk rises faster than the farm. Stakes sit at a jetty escrow for 30 days so claims can land.
